req.title: Return arbitrary status code
req.statement: The system shall respond to GET /status/<code> with an HTTP response bearing the requested status code, for codes 100 through 599.

doc.reasoning: The requirement mandates that GET /status/<code> returns exactly the requested HTTP status code for codes 100-599. To achieve high mutation kill rate: (1) EP tests cover representative codes from each class (2xx, 4xx, 5xx); (2) BVA tests probe the exact boundaries 100, 101, 599, 598; (3) NEG tests verify that out-of-range or malformed codes are rejected with 400; (4) DT tests cover special codes with custom bodies/headers (401, 418); (5) STC tests verify that the single-code path vs. weighted-choice path both work. Each test asserts the exact integer status code to catch off-by-one and comparison-flip mutations.

tests.name: test_status_exact_code_not_adjacent
trace: R-HTTPBIN-014: adjacent codes must not bleed into each other; catches off-by-one mutation in status_code assignment
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_status_exact_code_not_adjacent():
    r200 = client.get('/status/200')
    assert r200.status_code == 200
    r201 = client.get('/status/201')
    assert r201.status_code == 201
    assert r200.status_code != r201.status_code
